## Declarations and implementations

```plato
//==
// # Time-varying interfaces
//
// The single abstraction shared by every animated value in this layer: something
// that can be sampled at a moment in time. Tweens and oscillators implement it
// here (`motion-graphics.types.plato`); the keyframe and track types that also
// implement it are aspirational and live in `future/keyframes.types.plato`.

// A value that can be sampled at a moment in time. Tracks, tweens, and
// oscillators are all time-varying.
interface ITimeVarying<TValue>
{
    Sample(x: Self, time: Duration): TValue;
}
```
